Debug Build - A build made for development, with extra checks and little optimization, so you can step through the code.
한국어: Debug Build: 코드를 한 줄씩 따라가며 확인할 수 있도록 추가 검사를 넣고 최적화는 적게 한 개발용 빌드

dialogue.title: Logs on my phone
dialogue.setting: Too many logs in a test build

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, why does the app print so many logs on my phone?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because you run a debug build. A debug build has extra checks and little optimization.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So you can step through the code line by line.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a release build. A release build is optimized, and the debug extras are removed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do we remove the debug extras?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With conditional compilation. The compiler skips the lines inside `#if DEBUG`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So `track` prints only in a debug build?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. In a release build, that print line is not even compiled.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. Does conditional compilation keep secrets out of logs too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not always. Check your release build before you ship.
The debug build is slow but easy to debug.
